sole_research_target_acknowledgement: My sole research target is the full quadratic-form statement: for every dimension, independent real inputs with densities bounded by 1, and every real symmetric matrix with at least three eigenvalues of absolute value at least 1, prove one universal finite C with P(X^T A X in [t,t+h]) <= C h for every t and h>0, or give a valid counterexample.

latest_substantive_result.proven_scope: Diagonal target branch has bounded uniformly continuous density with constant pi; any form with a nonsingular 3x3 principal coordinate block B has conditional small-ball density bound (2*pi+3*sqrt(3))/sigma_min(B); flat rank-three projectors show one fixed principal triple can lose dimension.

first_unresolved_implication: Convert distributed rank-three spectral curvature into a dimension-free shell-volume bound without selecting one poorly conditioned coordinate triple.
next_concrete_attempt: Prove a principal-pivot regularity certificate using 3x3 or 4x4 nonsingular principal blocks, obtaining qualitative bounded-density existence for every fixed admissible A and isolating universality as the only remaining L-infinity issue; then test whether the 4-variable local bound can support a continuity upgrade.
